title: Gameknight283 Official Server
description: The Official Gameknight283 Minecraft Survival Server.
body:
Welcome to the Official Gameknight283 Server – a place where you can dive straight into classic Minecraft survival.
What you’ll find

A steady progression from starter tools to Nether and End challenges.
A friendly community with active moderators who help new players get settled.

Our rules:

Play fair, be respectful, and keep chat friendly. No hacks, no griefing, no spam.
We’ve tweaked a few performance settings to keep lag low, so everyone enjoys a smooth experience.

Jump onto our Discord at https://discord.gg/FCzKQG9A5M for announcements and help.
Check our forum or Reddit for tips, showcases, and feedback.
Come join us and experience the simple joy of surviving together—one block at a time.
